content.text: Elon Musk confirms discussions with TSMC about Terafab chipmaking collaboration: The article attributes the initial TSMC-Terafab report to Tim Culpan's Culpium newsletter on Friday, October 2. It reports Musk's October 3 description of the matter as discussions, without elaboration, and characterizes possible operating or ownership arrangements as speculative. It also says Intel was expected to supply 14A technology at that time. (time=2026-10-03T14:50:50Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
